query: I am an employer or platform operator who made cash top-ups to my employees or platform workers’ CPF Accounts on their behalf. How do I claim corporate tax deductions?
reference_answer: Cash top-ups made to your employees or platform workers’ CPF Retirement Accounts/ Special Accounts, on the employees or platform workers’ behalf, are tax-deductible. You are able to claim tax deduction on the cash top-ups as part of your allowable business expenses when filing the income tax return (Form B) for self-employed person or (Form C-S/ Form C-S (Lite)/ Form C) for company.For more information, you may refer to the IRAS website onTop-Up of Employees’ CPF RetirementAccounts/ Special Accounts/ MediSave Accounts.
answer: To claim corporate tax deductions for making cash top-ups to employees' CPF Accounts, you need to keep detailed records of these transactions. You can then claim a deduction on your tax return, but ensure compliance with relevant tax laws and regulations. [Document 1] provides more specific guidance.
